title: 公路车胎gsr，c3045，c1406和high road体验
notes: Owner comparison (2025-08-10): CST C3045 recommended over Continental GSR as a training tire; its water-channel tread seemed to dry faster on wet roads, grip similar to GSR, truer to nominal width and lighter. Maxxis High Road (clearance stock) felt clearer and grippier but harsher. CST C1406 is a cheap yellow-edge durability tire.
